title: DevOps
description: Getting software from a commit to a running, observable, recoverable production system: Linux, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and reliability practice.

default_stack.language: Bash and YAML (Terraform HCL for infrastructure; a small Node.js service as the thing being deployed)
default_stack.runtime: Docker, kind (local Kubernetes), and GitHub Actions
default_stack.test: bats-core plus linters (hadolint, actionlint, terraform validate)

safety: Never commit secrets: API keys, tokens, and passwords live in a git-ignored .env file, with a committed .env.example that holds placeholder values only.

Default to local infrastructure (Docker, kind, LocalStack). Create real cloud resources only when the learner explicitly asks, inside free-tier limits, with a budget alert, and always provide the teardown command.
Never run destructive commands (rm -rf, terraform destroy, kubectl delete, docker system prune) outside the project directory or a disposable local cluster.
Never store cloud credentials in a repository, a container image, or CI logs; use the CI provider's secret store.
